releaseName: UI Modernization, Distinguishable Button System & Categorized Workspaces

highlights: Categorized Sidebar Architecture: 4 distinct groups (Strategy & Core, Cambridge 4-Skills, Methodology & Drills, Tracking & System) with colored category dots and informative badges
Mobile Horizontal Category Filter: Segmented bar for instant filtering between Exam, Advantage Drills, and Core dashboards on smartphones
Distinguishable Hero Button Palette: Tactical tactile feedback, deep glowing action buttons (.btn-hero-exam, .btn-hero-advantage, .btn-hero-audio, .btn-pulse, .btn-cat-ghost)

Interactive Horizontal Chip Selector Bars: Replaced dull dropdown selects with tactile chips for Reading Passages, Listening Sections, Writing Essay Types, Speaking Exam Sets, Grammar Syntax, and Vocab Topics
Subcategorized Tool Switchers (.btn-sub-tool): Smooth numbered tool navigation across IELTS Advantage Studio, Grammar Coach, and Vocabulary Vault
AI Tutor Quick Prompt Chips: Instant 1-touch exploration of IELTS Advantage 100% Rule, Band 8 Cue Card openings, and GRA Inversion
Full synchronization to Android Release APK, standalone Offline Local Engine, and website downloads
